description: Self-attention locality of every head of the dense VOSR2, measured by tools/attn_head_stats.py on 4 text-centred 512x512 crops of the Real-CE x4 train pairs (seed 11, FP32 on CPU, t=1, r=0). mass3x3: mean attention mass on the 3x3 token neighbourhood of the query. mean_distance: mean attention distance in tokens. pattern: mean attention weight at each offset (dy, dx) of the (2 radius + 1)^2 window around the query, row-major, over queries at least radius tokens from the border. Blocks x heads; heads with mass3x3 > attn_compression.local_threshold become local convs initialized from their pattern.
